metadata.title: SheetDB: TransactionTracker Process Knowledge Graph
metadata.description: System architecture, operations, state tracking, and recovery actions for the transactional rollback manager in SheetDB.

nodes.description: Generic LIFO rollback manager coordinating database transaction steps, backups, and restores.
An internal stack array storing recorded operations in chronological sequence.
Registers a newly inserted record primary key to be deleted upon transaction rollback.
Registers a record update with a backup copy of its original pre-update state.
Registers a record deletion with a hydrated backup model to be re-inserted upon rollback.
Registers a bulk synchronization step (delete and rewrite) with filters and backup models.
Executes rollback steps in LIFO (Last-In, First-Out) reverse order to restore the database to its pre-transaction state.
The active dynamic table repository representing a Sheet database table interface.
The base data model wrapper representing a validated record structure.

edges.description: Maintains an internal array stack of recovery step objects.
Pushes a deletion recovery step into the steps array.
Pushes an update recovery step with baseline state backup.
Pushes an insert recovery step containing the deleted record's backup.
Pushes a restore_sync step containing target query filters and backup state.
Processes the steps array backwards to reverse modifications in the correct dependency order.
Invokes ORM APIs (remove, update, insert) to revert table rows.
Accepts a hydrated model instance representing the deleted state.
Accepts an array of backup model instances to restore upon rollback.
